item.title: $1.1M in stolen concert investments lands Texas show promotion scammer in prison
item.description: Carlos Desean Goodspeed, 45, was sentenced to 75 months in prison for wire fraud on Feb. 18. Goodspeed had been indicted in 2024 and pleaded guilty to the charge in October.
